name: A second character login on one connection gets no spell visual or sound rows again
contract: Requires CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1. The display patch stream is sent at every character login, and the client
keeps its spell visual and sound rows until it exits. The Extensions DLL restarts the game sound for every
SMSG_PATCH_SOUND_ENTRIES (0x098B) row and for every SMSG_PATCH_SPELL_VISUAL_KIT (0x092D) row that overwrites
one it holds, so resending the kits at a second character login froze the client for about 1.2 s per row.
Those rows are the same for every character, so one connection gets them once: after a relog on the same
session the stream (SMSG_PATCH_LOADING_SCREENS 0x05F8) is sent again, but kit 99025 and sound entry 10045 are not.
